summary: This plan is for a simple lost-and-found board for your campus desk. Anyone who finds something can report it with a short description, the place it was found and the date it was found. Everyone can see the whole board, look at a single item, or see only the items still waiting for their owners. When an owner collects an item, the desk marks it as claimed and records the owner's name. An item that is already claimed cannot be claimed again. Since you had no preference on your three questions, we chose the simplest options: anyone using the board can mark an item as claimed (no passwords or staff accounts), the owner's name is shown on claimed items like the rest of the item's details, and items are never removed from the board automatically. Some questions for you to consider before we build: Would you like only desk staff to be able to mark items as claimed, so that someone cannot falsely claim an item through the board? Would you prefer to hide owners' names from the public for privacy? Would you like old unclaimed items to be removed after a certain number of days? None of these are included in this plan unless you ask for them.

data.name: Found item
fields: Item number (given automatically by the system so each item can be looked up)
Status: waiting for owner, or claimed (starts as waiting for owner)
Owner's name (empty until the item is claimed)

endpoints.does: Report a found item by giving a short description, where it was found and the date it was found. The item is added to the board as waiting for its owner.
Show all items on the board, both claimed and still waiting.
Show only the items that are still waiting for their owners.
Show one item and all its details.
Mark an item as claimed when the owner collects it, and write down the owner's name.

rules: A report must include a short description, where the item was found and the date it was found; a report missing any of these is refused.
Marking an item as claimed must include the owner's name; a claim without a name is refused.
An item that has already been claimed cannot be claimed again; the attempt is refused and the original owner's name stays unchanged.
Looking up or claiming an item number that does not exist is refused with a message saying the item was not found.
